summary: Fixed endpoints 400 vs 409 contract for missing session_id. Root cause: the CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID daemon-side fallback (routes/overlay.js:150) was unconditional — it fired for any agent claiming without an explicit session_id, including agents not in the registry, silently adopting the daemon's session and routing to the 409 dispatcher-rejection path instead of the 400 check. Fix: added agentInRegistry guard so the env fallback only activates when the agent IS found in ctx.state.agents but has no resolvable session. Unregistered agents with no session_id now correctly return 400 "session_id required". endpoints.test.js passes; full suite 174/176 with the 2 pre-existing failures (touch-agent workspace-pin git repo check, cursor-e2e session registration) unrelated to this change.
